target_customer: Consumers who want cheese and dairy products that taste like dairy at a similar price, and food makers who would license the plant-made casein
problem: Plant-based cheeses taste and melt worse than dairy cheese, so most people do not switch. Nobell makes real dairy proteins in soybean plants to close the taste gap at a competitive cost.
business_model: Plant-derived dairy protein (casein) production, sold as ingredients and as branded cheese products
product_category: Food tech, molecular farming, plant-based dairy

founders.name: Magi Richani
founders.background_notes: A 2021 Food Ingredients First article calls her an engineer by training who led more than four years of R&D on the patented method. Prior employers and schools were not found in a source I opened.

competitors.name: Perfect Day
competitors.what: Animal-free dairy proteins made by microbial fermentation, pivoting to a B2B ingredient model in late 2017
competitors.traction_then: Company founded 2014; first patent for animal-free dairy proteins reported in Feb 2018

technical_complexity.rationale: Producing casein in transgenic soybean plants needed plant biotechnology and protein science, plus years of R&D before a product, far beyond a small software team.

defensibility.rationale: A 2021 article describes a patented method for producing dairy proteins in soybeans, and regulatory and crop-scale hurdles slow copycats.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Fermentation rivals such as Perfect Day and Those Vegan Cowboys pursued animal-free casein by a different route; no incumbent bought or copied Nobell's plant route in the sources found.

market_need_then: Plant-based cheese was a known weak spot among vegan products in 2017, with taste and melt cited as the barrier. The YC page frames the target as the 99 percent unwilling to compromise on taste and price. Dated demand figures for 2017 were not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission-led, pitched around taste and price parity for mainstream eaters

branding.community_and_virality: Celebrity-linked investor FootPrint Coalition (Robert Downey Jr.) drew press in 2021, and Red Bull and Forbes ran profiles of the founder in 2022 and 2023 per the YC page headlines.

brand_strength.rationale: The brand shows up mainly through founder profiles and investor coverage. No consumer product with a recognizable brand identity was found at the time of research.

outcome_analysis: Nobell stayed active and raised a reported $75M Series B in July 2021 on the strength of a patented plant-based casein approach, with over $25M raised before that round per the article. The long R&D path and the lack of a shipped consumer product mean the outcome is still open, and the next test is commercial scale and regulatory clearance.
notes: Company site www.nobellfoods.com did not resolve from the research environment. The earlier rounds totalling over $25M before July 2021 were not itemized in sources I opened. Aggregators agree on the Series B but vary on investor lists. A design portfolio listing claims a branding agency handled naming and brand world, seen only in a search snippet and unverified.
